## Prompt
```text
GOAL: Editorial long-form essay web page for River Notes, an essay with four chapters about Mekong river boats, for readers to read calmly from opening to closing chapter. One index.html with inline CSS and JavaScript, no libraries; a Google Fonts link is allowed.
CONTENT: Scene 1: "River Notes", "Mekong river boats". Scene 2: "Chapter 1" and [ADD: chapter 1 title and essay prose]. Scene 3: "Chapter 2" and [ADD: chapter 2 title and essay prose]. Scene 4: "Chapter 3" and [ADD: chapter 3 title and essay prose]. Scene 5: "Chapter 4" and [ADD: chapter 4 title and essay prose]. Add no other words or facts. Omit any [ADD: ...] slot completely (never invent a replacement name, subtitle, chapter title, or placeholder essay prose to fill a slot), and report it.
SCENES: Natural document height (no fixed Track vh). All percentages are shares of the document.
Motif: A traditional Mekong river boat silhouette in profile, recognisable with no label: (a) main masses: an elongated curved wooden hull tapering upward at prow and stern (4.5:1 width-to-height) with a low arched cabin canopy spanning the middle third, filled in primary ink (#171717 on light ground, #FAF8F4 on dark ground); (b) identifying parts: 1 upturned bow stempost, 1 raised sternpost with a long-tail rudder shaft angled down 22deg, 3 curved canopy ribs dividing the roof into 3 bays, and 2 horizontal water-ripple bands beneath the keel in highlight tone (#5C564E light, #CFC9BE dark); (c) surface detail: 4 hull plank strake seams, 1 prow trim band, and rudder blade accent in terracotta (#7A2E2E light, #C97A7A dark).
Draw it with care as one inline SVG: closed, filled, curved paths in at least three distinct palette hex tones (main body, lighter highlight, accent detail — bound to CSS variables inheriting each section's theme, never a hardcoded dark fill) with a tight viewBox. No stick lines and no bare circles or rectangles standing in for the object. Whenever a scene or inverted band turns dark, update those CSS variables so dark SVG fills switch to light hex tones and every part stays clear across every scene.
Scene 1 | 0-15% | centred 60ch column, full boat motif above title at scale 1, 0deg, #FAF8F4 ground | boat translates 0 -> 4% X, 1px hairline draws 60% -> 100% at 0-14% | hold 0-10, out 10-14
Scene 2 | 15-38% | 60ch column, motif shifted right (translateX 12%), scale 1.25 cropped to bow stempost, #FAF8F4 ground | motif translates 4% -> 12% X and scales 1 -> 1.25 at 15-24%, hairline sweeps 100% | in 16-21, hold 21-32, out 32-37
Scene 3 | 38-62% | full-width inverted band (#171717 ground, #FAF8F4 text), motif scaled 1.45 cropped to 3-ribbed cabin canopy | field switches to #171717 at 37-39%, canopy ribs brighten, motif scales 1.25 -> 1.45 | in 39-44, hold 44-56, out 56-61
Scene 4 | 62-86% | 60ch column on #FAF8F4 ground, motif shifted left (translateX -12%), rotated -4deg, scale 1.35 cropped to sternpost and rudder | field returns to #FAF8F4 at 61-63%, motif translates 12% -> -12% X and rotates 0 -> -4deg | in 63-68, hold 68-80, out 80-85
Scene 5 | 86-100% | 60ch closing column on #FAF8F4 ground, full boat motif settled right (translateX 18%) at scale 0.9, 0deg | motif scales 1.35 -> 0.9, rotates -4 -> 0deg, canopy ribs dim to opacity 0.6, ripples clip to 55% | in 87-92, hold 92-100
MOTION: Natural-height sections in reading order; drive transform, opacity and clip-path from each section's intersection/scroll progress (0 to 1), eased cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), reversible on scroll back. Never prevent native scroll. Smooth progress with drawn += (p - drawn) * (1 - exp(-dt / 120ms)); set drawn = p on load, resize and anchor jump. Scene 1 is complete at 0% and the last scene at 100%.
LOOK: Ground #FAF8F4, text #171717, accent #7A2E2E; inverted band ground #171717, text #FAF8F4, SVG accent #C97A7A; display Bodoni Moda with Georgia, serif fallback, body Instrument Sans with sans-serif fallback. Display clamp(36px, 5.2vw, 144px). The main line of every scene, also a category or subject line, is display type: scale down cleanly inside 60ch columns or mobile frames so the longest word fits inside its container with at least 24px margin and zero right-edge clipping, and never under 36px. Body at least 16px, measure at most 60ch. Keep the section background and inverted background layer strictly behind both motif and text (background z-index 0, motif layer z-index 1, text layer z-index 2); drive opacity on only ONE wrapper per scene so inner .copy/.mask elements stay at opacity 1 (never leaving Scene 1 hidden at p = 0); at p = 0 the page starts in Scene 1's opening ground (never inverted at rest), and when Scene 3 inverts, drive ground, text and motif colours together through inherited section CSS variables at every breakpoint (>= 4.5:1 contrast; never use filter invert alone and never hardcode dark text under mobile media queries). Line height 1.05 for display, 1.5 for body, mask padding 0.1em.
LAYOUT: Full-width edge-to-edge sections (especially the inverted-field band in Scene 3) enclosing an inner reading column at most 60ch wide centred with margin-inline auto and 24px phone gutters; put overflow hidden on every motif box (bound SVG/motif containers to max-width 100% of their parent, never exceeding a 60ch wrapper) and overflow-x clip on html, body and every section so transformed artwork never causes sideways scroll; no sticky box. At 1440x900, 390x844 and 360x640, place the motif box above the reading text in separate non-overlapping regions so text and motif never overlap and nothing clips or scrolls sideways.
ASSETS: None: draw everything in SVG and CSS. No stock, generated or placeholder media.
FALLBACKS: Base HTML and CSS is the static version: semantic sections in reading order, every word visible at opacity 1, compact auto-height static sections (no 100svh spacer above text) above the fold with zero overlap. Keep keyboard scene-jump links visually hidden until focused (:focus-visible) unless a top navbar was requested, so only active copy animates at rest. JavaScript adds the class that turns on scroll-linked motion only when prefers-reduced-motion is not reduce, switches live when that changes, and removes it if setup throws.
Keyboard: every link is reachable, has visible focus, and focusing it scrolls to the hold of its scene. A deep link lands on that hold. Reload and resize draw the state of the current position.
Waiting over 300ms shows the drawn still or a quiet role="status" line, never a blank screen.
AVOID: sections that look like stacked template blocks while motion is on, scroll progress bars and decorative loading bars, card grids, glowing borders, neon or purple-blue gradients, pill badges, text on top of media, bounce, springs, scroll hijacking, cursor followers, invented statistics, testimonials, logos and stock media.
DONE WHEN: At 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100% on 1440x900, 390x844 and 360x640 the screen matches SCENES, with no overlapping text, empty screen, sideways scroll or console error.
Reduced motion and no JavaScript show every word. Tab shows each link in view. Reload at 50% draws the 50% state. Report each check as passed, failed or not run.
```
